feed.subtitle: I'm a Ph.D. student in Computer Science at The University of Texas at Dallas (UTD), working with Prof. Blaine Hoak in the IRIS Lab (Intelligent systems Robustness, Interpretability, and Security) as a Graduate Research Assistant on problems at the intersection of adversarial machine learning and computer security. Broadly, I'm interested in interpretable and robust AI models in security-critical applications.
